## 4.14 Brackets and braces

Brackets and braces are used at the left-hand side of systems to group similar instruments together.

Normally, instruments of the same family (e.g. woodwind, brass, percussion) are bracketed together. Percussion instruments and solo instruments are not normally bracketed. Keyboard staves are joined with a brace, but an organ pedal staff is not braced to the organ manuals.

Small groups of instruments are usually not bracketed at all.

Instruments bracketed, sub-bracketed or braced together normally also have their staves joined by barlines.

Sibelius First chooses where brackets and braces go by default, but you can change it if you like.

This was a VS Code 1.71 regression. The workaround is to set the option back to `false`:

```json
"editor.bracketPairColorization.enabled": true,
"editor.bracketPairColorization.independentColorPoolPerBracketType": false
```

With `true`, 1.71 can assign every nesting level the first bracket color, so they appear uniformly yellow. Updating VS Code is the durable fix; 1.71.0 is from September 2022 and no longer supported.
